entities.summary: Alhaji Collins Dauda is a teacher, politician, former Ghanaian Minister for Lands and Natural Resources; and Water Resources, Works and Housing and member of the Eighth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing Asutifi South Constituency He is from Mahame in the Brong Ahafo Region. Hon Alhaji Collins Dauda attended Mim Secondary School from 1973 to 1981 where he obtained his general certificate of Education ordinary and advanced levels.
